scripts.text:
UPDATE EXTRACT.KS_ConsolidatedAPPEALS
SET ReportDate = DATEADD(ms,-3,DATEADD(d,1,DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, -1, GETDATE())-1, -1))),
ReportRunDate = GETDATE()
WHERE PROCESS_TYPE = 'Appeals_Vendor'

UPDATE EXTRACT.KS_ConsolidatedFairHearings
SET ReportDate = DATEADD(ms,-3,DATEADD(d,1,DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, -1, GETDATE())-1, -1))),
ReportRunDate = GETDATE()
WHERE PROCESS_TYPE = 'FH_Vendor'
